answer.part: Rule: most warriors + buildings; tokens/pawns excluded. Ordinary tie=no ruler; Eyrie wins tie if it has at least one piece there. Vagabond cannot rule or prevent rule.
Move positive group along linking path to adjacent clearing; rule origin or destination (or both), checking each move. Same pieces may move repeatedly. Rivers are not paths absent an explicit effect.

Battle requires your warrior/pawn and enemy defender in clearing, not rule. Defender may play matching ambush (birds wild); attacker can foil with matching ambush; foil=no hits, otherwise ambush deals 2 immediately and is discarded. If attackers all removed, battle ends. Before-roll effects (attacker orders when both sides have effects); roll higher die attacker/lower defender, ties equal, each side capped by own warriors; Alliance defense reverses dice; Vagabond uses undamaged swords. Resolve after-roll effects (attacker orders when both sides have effects). Count extra hits uncapped and subtract ignored; attacker gets one defenseless hit if defender has no warriors (Vagabond instead: no undamaged swords). Deal hits: hit side chooses removals, warriors before buildings/tokens, and orders its removal effects; both sides deal counted hits despite casualties. Remover scores 1 VP per enemy building/token, including defender/outside battle. Vagabond hits damage items.

Per icon, Marquise/Eyrie/Alliance activate matching-suit workshop/roost/sympathy; each piece once per turn. Vagabond exhausts a face-up undamaged hammer per icon, must be in a clearing matching every icon, and may reuse pawn. Three-color ? accepts any suit. Item card requires corresponding item token in supply. Cannot craft identical persistent effect already in play.

Own Daylight at 10+ VP: activate dominance from hand, remove score marker, stop scoring VP. Win check at start of own Birdsong: matching mouse/rabbit/fox controls three clearings; bird controls two diagonally opposite corners. Earlier condition does not win immediately. Activated card cannot be removed/replaced.

Spent dominance goes near map as available instead of discard. In own Daylight spend matching card to take available dominance into hand; bird dominance requires bird payment (bird can pay for non-bird). Taking and activation separate; neither uses faction action allowance.

Two players: remove all four dominance cards; shuffle shared deck, each draws 3. Cover four R slots with ruins. Map supply: 2 boots,2 bags,1 crossbow,1 hammer,2 swords,2 tea,2 coins. With Vagabond, hide R bag/boot/hammer/sword one per shuffled ruin stack; without it ruins empty. Faction setup order Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond; distinct from turn order.

Only Marquise places pieces in Keep clearing; others may move into it. Keep cannot be placed again if removed. When any Marquise warriors are removed, may spend one card matching clearing to put them in Keep clearing rather than supply; applies outside battle. No Keep, no hospital destination.

Daylight: craft with workshops, then up to 3 actions plus 1 per bird card spent outside an action, in any order. March up to 2 moves, one compound action; no interruption between to spend bird/take action. Recruit one at each recruiter, once/turn. Overwork spends matching sawmill-clearing card for 1 wood there.

Build in clearing Marquise rules, open slot; choose type, take leftmost building. Pay column cost in wood from target or other ruled clearings connected via unbroken chain of ruled clearings. Place and score uncovered track VP. Requires full cost, building and legal slot.

Birdsong order: Emergency Orders draw one if hand empty; Add to Decree one or two hand cards, max one bird, any columns; A New Roost only if none on map, place roost + 3 warriors in clearing with fewest warriors where all can be placed.

Craft with roosts first; resolve all cards columns Recruit→Move→Battle→Build, free order within column. Suits: Recruit roost clearing; Move origin; Battle clearing; Build target; bird wild. Recruit one warrior at chosen roost (Charismatic 2); Move at least one under normal rules; Battle initiate with Eyrie warriors vs enemy; Build roost where rule, open slot, no roost. Inability fully to complete any required action causes immediate Turmoil; cannot skip/continue columns.

Lose 1 VP per bird Decree card including Viziers; discard Decree except Viziers; flip current leader down and choose face-up replacement (if none, flip all up); retuck Viziers per new leader. End Daylight and do full Evening: score roost track, draw 1 + uncovered bonuses, discard to 5. Map warriors/buildings remain.

Other player removes sympathy or moves warriors into sympathetic clearing: add one matching hand card per affected move (birds count), not per warrior. If no matching incl bird, show hand and Alliance draws deck card to Supporters. Full stack: incoming card discarded, but payment/no-match draw still occurs. Battle alone no trigger unless removes sympathy.

Birdsong: all Revolts before any Spread Sympathy; repeat either as able. Spent supporters match target suit, birds wild. Revolt: sympathetic clearing, no base, suit matching base still on board; spend 2; remove all enemy pieces, score 1 per enemy building/token, place base, warriors equal matching-suit sympathetic clearings incl target, plus 1 Officer. Spread: unsympathetic clearing adjacent by path (any if no sympathy); pay shown amount +1 matching supporter if one other player has ≥3 warriors there; place token, score uncovered VP; one per clearing; Keep ban applies. After spreading begins cannot Revolt, so new sympathy cannot fund same-Birdsong revolt.

Train: spend hand card matching clearing with base, place one supply warrior in Officers; supporters cannot pay. Each officer enables one Evening operation; not consumed. Up to officer count operations, Move/Battle/Recruit/Organize, any order/repetition. Base removed: discard supporters matching its clearing incl birds; remove half officers rounded up; with no bases, discard supporters to max 5.
answer.ruling: Train by spending a hand card matching a clearing with a base to place one supply warrior in Officers; Supporters cannot pay. Each officer allows one Evening operation; officers are not consumed. Take up to officer count operations in any order/repetition: Move (one normal move), Battle (initiate one battle), Recruit (one warrior at one clearing with a base), Organize (remove one Alliance warrior from an unsympathetic clearing, place sympathy there, score uncovered VP). Organize needs legal token placement, no supporters, adjacency, or Martial Law. When a base is removed, discard all supporters matching its clearing including birds, remove half officers rounded up, and if no bases remain discard excess supporters down to five.

answer.part: Refresh: count tea already face-up on track, ready 2 items each, then 3 more; tea refreshed now adds nothing. Optional Slip to adjacent clearing/forest, no boot, even hostile warriors, ignore effects preventing movement out. Daylight Move exhaust 1 boot plus 1 if destination has any hostile faction warriors; ignores rule, no entering forest, from forest only adjacent clearing. Forest Evening Rest returns damaged items face-up to Satchel; ready tea/coins/bags to tracks if able; does not refresh undamaged exhausted. Always draw 1 + face-up track coins even after Rest.

Explore: exhaust torch in ruin clearing; take hidden item face-up to Satchel/track, score 1 if item taken; remove ruin when last item taken, freeing slot. Quest in matching clearing: exhaust two listed items, complete, choose VP equal matching completed quests incl this one or draw 2 cards; replace quest. Repair: exhaust hammer, move one damaged item to Satchel keeping face; ready tea/coins/bags to track if space.

Remove one warrior of non-Hostile faction → Hostile immediately (except allied battle-loss rule). Own-turn battle Infamy: 1 extra VP per hostile piece removed except warrior that first made Hostile; none on others' turn or from Strike. Aid cannot undo Hostility but may take crafted item. Strike exhaust crossbow to remove one enemy warrior; another faction piece only if that faction has no warriors in clearing; check hostility; no battle/Infamy.

4+ players, Vagabond own Daylight at 10+ VP may activate dominance to coalition with non-coalition player having lowest VP among others (choose tied). Put marker on partner board, stop scoring. If partner wins, Vagabond wins too incl dominance. Partners not enemies; Hostile partner resets to Indifferent; no Allied powers granted.

Card overrides Law; Law overrides Learning to Play; faction rule prevails over incompatible general rule. Cannot is absolute unless explicitly overridden; ordinary card does not bypass it absent explicit override.
Unclear simultaneous effect order/decision: current player chooses; battle effects at same timing: attacker chooses. March's two moves are compound, cannot interrupt for bird spend/action.

At-start before all phase effects; at-end after all phase effects before next phase. Once last turn step begins, no other actions except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions; no ordinary Daylight actions after it.
Hand size public, contents private; reveal only if instructed. Face-up piles searchable/inspectable; deck not. Deals nonbinding; transfer cards only as instructed; actions need no consent.

Empty shared deck: immediately shuffle discard into new deck. Birds substitute for any non-bird suit, even multiple same suit. For prompted non-bird give/discard, birds count as that suit; non-bird cannot meet explicit bird requirement.
Finite pieces, no proxies. If cannot place all requested, place maximum possible, not fewer voluntarily. Does not waive costs/prerequisites or Eyrie's obligation to complete Decree actions.
Place from supply or leftmost track; remove to supply or rightmost empty track. Removed items permanently removed. Simultaneous removals all happen before removal effects trigger.
Forced action resolved as if affected player chose it, retaining their abilities/restrictions; forced player makes battle decisions.
Enemy cannot place in Keep clearing; replace cannot bypass restriction. Replace requires legal removal and placement. Swap ignores move/place restrictions.
If simultaneous 30 VP, tied player closest clockwise to current player wins, including current player.
Forest adjacent to touching clearings without crossing printed path, and forests separated by one path; Winter river also divides forests. Fall has no special rules.

Marquise supply 25 warriors, 8 wood. Keep any corner; one warrior every clearing except diagonally opposite. Place one sawmill/workshop/recruiter among Keep and adjacent clearings, any combination respecting slots. Other five of each building on tracks right-to-left, leftmost empty.

Supply 20 warriors; one roost + 6 warriors in corner not another player's starting corner, diagonally opposite a starting corner if possible. Choose leader, others face-up; tuck 2 bird Viziers in leader columns. Other 6 roosts track right-to-left.
Supply 10 warriors; three bases in matching board spaces; ten sympathy on track. Draw 3 extra cards face-down to Supporters, separate from 3-card hand. No map pieces or officers.

Choose Thief/Tinker/Ranger, pawn any forest; shuffle quests, display 3 face-up; others' relationships Indifferent. Take character S-marked starting items: tea/coins/bags face-up on matching tracks, others face-up Satchel; unused S items return box.
Minimum recommended Reach: 17 for 2p, 18 for 3p, 21 for 4p. Faction values Marquise 10, Eyrie 7, Vagabond 5, Alliance 3. Any mix totaling ≥17 allowed for adventurous groups.
Birdsong: 1 wood per sawmill (even multiple in a clearing), limited by common supply of 8. Overwork in Daylight spends matching card for 1 wood. Evening draws 1 plus uncovered bonuses, discard to 5.
Recruit once/turn, 1 at each recruiter. If supply short, place max available and choose among eligible recruiters.
Eyrie crafted items score 1 VP rather than printed; extra crafting-point effects still apply. Builder ignores Disdain.

Builder Viziers Recruit/Move; ignores Disdain. Charismatic Recruit/Battle; Recruit 2. Commander Move/Battle; +1 attacker hit. Despot Move/Build; removing ≥1 enemy building/token in battle gives +1 VP besides normal removal.
No. Charismatic Recruit requires 2 at one roost. With only one warrior the Decree action cannot fully complete, so immediate Turmoil; cannot satisfy it by placing one.
No. Warrior caps still apply. Defending Alliance takes higher die, attacker lower.
Supporters inspectable by Alliance; spend only for suit; cannot craft; not hand cards or hand-limit count.
No. Finish all Revolts before starting Spread Sympathy; cannot go back during that Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot fund revolt.
No: needs ≥3 warriors of one other player, not two players with 2 each. Martial Law adds supporter to spreading cost; Organize has no supporter/Martial Law cost.

Placing warriors and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger. Moving warriors into sympathy does, including allied warriors accompanying Vagabond; one matching card per affected move, or Alliance draws one if none match.

Evening operations up to officer count: Move, Battle, Recruit, Organize; any order/repetition, officers not used up. Recruit places one warrior at one clearing with base. Then draw 1 + uncovered bonuses and discard to 5.
Pawn cannot be removed. Remove-all-enemy-pieces effects instead damage 3 Vagabond items.

Rolled-hit max equals all undamaged swords in Satchel, face up/down; exhausted undamaged count, damaged do not. Defenseless only with no undamaged swords. Each hit damages an undamaged item; excess ignored if none remain.

Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel move immediately to empty matching tracks, each max 3. Exhausting tracked item returns it to Satchel. Damage preserves face. Damaged items cannot pay; exhaustion requires face-up undamaged item.

Evening capacity = 6 + 2 per face-up track bag, counting Satchel and Damaged box; track items excluded. Permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within capacity. Not checked on acquisition.

Rest returns damaged items to Satchel face-up; ready tea/coins/bags to tracks if able; does not ready undamaged exhausted items. Birdsong Refresh readies exhausted; Repair uses hammer and moves damaged item retaining face.

Aid exhausts one face-up undamaged item of any type, gives matching-clearing card to player with faction pieces there (even Hostile), then may take crafted item from their box; no item required. Relationship advancement needs listed number of Aids same turn; each Aid counts toward one step.

Allied subsequent Aid scores 2 VP. May move warriors of one Allied faction with pawn; their own movement rules apply; not on alone moves. As attacker may count one ally's warriors in battle clearing toward hit limit, but cannot use them against that ally.
After battle, ally becomes Hostile if more allied warriors removed as hits than items Vagabond damaged in that battle. Equal count does not trigger.

No mixed fox/rabbit in one clearing: current clearing must match all icons. Pawn can be reused, but exhaust one face-up undamaged hammer per icon. Crafted item may be taken immediately face-up to Satchel/track and used in another Daylight action if requirements met; supply item required.

Thief: boot, torch, tea, sword; Steal exhaust torch, take random card from player with faction pieces in clearing. Tinker: boot, torch, bag, hammer; Day Labor exhaust torch, take discard card matching clearing (bird always). Ranger: boot, torch, crossbow, sword; Hideout exhaust torch, repair 3 keeping faces, end Daylight/start Evening immediately.
Taking ruin's last item removes ruin and frees slot. Ordinary building placement cannot remove it; removal only when explicitly permitted.
Coalition partners are not enemies; coalition alone does not grant Allied relationship powers.
Warriors ordinary VP=0; building=1. First warrior causes Hostile and earns no Infamy. Second hostile warrior=1 Infamy; hostile building=1 removal +1 Infamy. Total 3 VP: 1 ordinary + 2 Infamy.
Hostile buildings only: 1 boot. Hostile warriors present: 1 boot + 1 extra boot total, even if several hostile factions.
Taking puts available dominance in hand; doesn't activate. Separate steps, neither takes Marquise action; activation own Daylight at 10+ VP.
Faction-piece ownership fixed to chosen faction/player except items. Items are not faction/enemy pieces; possession doesn't make them faction-owned.
Immediate effect resolves then crafting card discarded. Persistent effect stays in play and effect applies; outside hand, cannot spend/discard/use otherwise unless instructed.
Ambush and dominance cannot be crafted. Ambush: defender plays for 2 hits, attacker matching ambush foils defense. Dominance activates changed win condition or is spent for suit.
Randomly determine starting player/seating; score markers at 0; dice nearby. Faction setup order Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond, distinct from turn order.
30 VP victory immediately on any player's turn; no finishing action/phase/turn.
Battle requires your warrior or pawn and enemy in chosen clearing; enemy chosen as defender. No rule requirement.
Attacker orders same-timing before-roll and after-roll effects if both players have them. Hit-taking side orders effects triggered by its piece removals.
Add extra hits (not capped by warriors), subtract ignored hits.
Token taken from map supply into faction Crafted Items box; score card's printed VP subject to Eyrie Disdain. Crafting card discarded, token stays.
Eyrie activates roost, Alliance sympathy; suit from clearing. Three-color question mark accepts any suit.
Mobilize adds one hand card to Supporters; without base max 5, overflow discarded; with base unlimited. Craft/Mobilize/Train any order and number in Daylight.
Evening score VP on rightmost empty roost track space, draw 1 + uncovered bonuses, discard to 5; also happens after Turmoil.
Exhaust one sword to Battle. Exhausted sword cannot pay although it counts for hit cap if undamaged; action cost must be face-up undamaged.
Birdsong→Daylight→Evening, clockwise; next clockwise player begins after Evening.
Choose an undamaged item per hit; move to Damaged box without changing face. Already damaged cannot absorb hit. Ignore excess hits when no undamaged items remain.
Up to officer-count operations; each Recruit places one warrior at one clearing with base. Operations do not consume officers.
Any order and number, as ready undamaged items allow; repeat action types freely subject to their costs/requirements.

Exhaust one crossbow to remove one enemy warrior; only if that faction has no warriors there can remove another faction piece. Exhaust requires face-up undamaged crossbow; exhausted/damaged cannot pay.
